statement: The raw application table exposes application_id, application_name, and is_integrated under those output names, so their source-column overrides are unnecessary.
evidence_of_dependence: The second 'stg_pendo__application_history' entry is {'display_name':'display_name'}, replacing the earlier overrides; source selection uses mp.get(n,n).
alternative: The material index lists raw.application_history columns "id", "name", and "integrated", rather than application_id, application_name, and is_integrated.
reason: The overwritten mapping can prevent this staging model and its downstream dependencies from executing.

statement: Every retained source row already yields non-null values for all contract-required columns that the generated SQL does not explicitly filter.
target: staging.stg_pendo__user, staging.stg_pendo__account_history, staging.stg_pendo__visitor_history, staging.stg_pendo__feature_event, staging.stg_pendo__guide_event, staging.stg_pendo__visitor_account_history, staging.stg_pendo__poll, staging.stg_pendo__page_history, staging.stg_pendo__guide_history, staging.stg_pendo__group, staging.stg_pendo__poll_event, staging.stg_pendo__guide_step_history, staging.stg_pendo__feature_history, staging.stg_pendo__page_event, staging.stg_pendo__page_rule_history
evidence_of_dependence: wh=[]; only t.get('where_conditions',[]) and the user/event special cases populate filters; conversions otherwise use TRY_CAST without checking their results.
alternative: These tables declare "constraints: [not_null]" for required identifiers and, in several event tables, occurred_at; the contract describes deleting rows with "Invalid primary keys".
reason: Missing source values or failed conversions can leave unusable records in many downstream models.

statement: General-event account IDs need not be nullified when they fail the contract's account-ID pattern.
evidence_of_dependence: elif n=='account_id' and name=='stg_pendo__event': expr='CAST(account_id AS VARCHAR)'
reason: Invalid account identifiers would survive and affect account associations and aggregates.

statement: Guide and poll URLs do not require rejection when their trimmed values lack an HTTP or HTTPS prefix.
evidence_of_dependence: expr=f"CASE WHEN {n if src==n else base} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {base} END" if n=='url' else base
alternative: Both contracts require "url IS NULL OR url ~ '^https?://'" with "on_failure: nullify_field".
reason: Malformed URLs remain available to downstream analyses instead of being nullified.

statement: Dotted IPv4 matching is the intended validation rule despite the contract's different literal IPv4 expression.
alternative: The documented expression is "^([0-9]{1,3}){3}[0-9]{1,3}$", without literal dots.
reason: The implementation changes which IP values survive validation across five event tables.

statement: Checking the allowed user types before lowercasing and trimming produces the required retained user population.
evidence_of_dependence: The SELECT uses 'LOWER(TRIM(user_type))', while wh includes "user_type IN ('system','internal','api','external')".
alternative: The contract requires "user_type = LOWER(TRIM(user_type))" with "on_failure: correct", supporting normalization before rejecting values outside the allowed set.
reason: Correctable uppercase or padded user types would be deleted instead of standardized.

statement: Directly casting visitor last_visit timestamps is equivalent to the contract's local-time string-truncation procedure.
evidence_of_dependence: The timestamp-special-case tuple contains 'last_visit_at' but not 'last_visit', so last_visit falls through to TRY_CAST(last_visit AS TIMESTAMP).
alternative: The implementation notes prescribe "TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(timestamp_field, 1, 23) AS TIMESTAMP)" and say to ignore the timezone suffix.
reason: A different parse result or conversion failure changes the visitor profile's last-visit value.

statement: Directly casting nonempty user deleted_at strings is equivalent to the contract's local-time string-truncation procedure.
alternative: The implementation notes prescribe truncating timestamp strings to their first 23 characters before conversion.
reason: Any parsing difference affects deletion timestamps, though this field is optional.

statement: raw.group_data is the intended source for the group staging model specified as reading raw.group.
alternative: The group contract states "source_table: raw.group"; the material index instead exposes raw.group_data.
reason: The substitution is plausible but determines the entire group population and its downstream enrichment.

statement: No guide-step source rows contain an empty guide_id requiring deletion.
evidence_of_dependence: The generator adds no guide-step-specific WHERE clause and does not translate column validation_rules into filters.
alternative: The contract explicitly requires "guide_id IS NOT NULL AND guide_id != ''" with "on_failure: delete_row".
reason: Empty identifiers would survive and could distort guide-step associations or counts.
